entries.name: Companion Cavalry: Conquest
entries.text: Unit-unique: global +100 piercing/slashing/blunt DMG on press 3, +Sworn Guard buff 18s. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Companion Cavalry: Billowing Winds
entries.text: Unit-unique: +9% movement speed, +10% unit DMG. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.name: Health & Resistance Doctrine V
entries.text: -5% DMG taken, alt for Leadership. Filler.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Full Bot (Achilles' Wings: +20% movement speed, +100% Imperial Stormbolt charge dmg, renames unit). Hero pairing: Any. Playstyle kit: X-move in; press 3 for buffs (usable even while hero fighting -- +100 all dmg stats wherever you are on the map); press 1 when close but not in contact (if low armor/low HP target, let that 1 do a bit of dps, else proceed instantly); cancel it with V and instantly press 2 very shortly after contact; cancel that press 2 with V once ~70% of the unit has impaled spears and press the new 1; try to X-move out at the end of the 1 without cancelling too soon. "This is the recommended playstyle vs units you know you can optimize DPS versus. If you need any immediate actions, prioritise the 2 (Storm Pound)." No separate "Example Build" section given beyond the doctrine list. steps.text: X-move in; press 3 for buffs (usable even while hero fighting, gives +100 all dmg stats wherever you are on the map).

Press 1 when close but not in contact (let it tick briefly vs low armor/HP targets); cancel with V and instantly press 2 very shortly after contact; cancel that 2 with V once ~70% of the unit has impaled spears, then press the new 1; try to X-move out at the end of the 1 without cancelling too soon.
If immediate action is needed, prioritise the 2 (Storm Pound) over the combo.
